title: Pagination
description: Page numbers with a clear current page: ink-filled, everything else quiet.
usage: For lists longer than a screen. Show the current page and its neighbours; collapse the rest into an ellipsis. On mobile, the compact form (prev / next + position) is enough.
a11y: A <nav> with its own aria-label; the current page carries aria-current="page" and keeps its filled state on hover. Prev/next links are named ("Previous page", "Next page"); their arrow icons and the compact form's text arrows are aria-hidden and mirror in RTL so they point in the reading direction. The ellipsis is aria-hidden. A disabled prev/next is an <a> without href and with aria-disabled="true", so it is out of the Tab order; .disabled remains as a deprecated alias that only stops the pointer. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
